QuestInfo.name: A Withered Lotus
QuestInfo.0: Commander Orchid's twin brother, #b#p1404005##k! He was always at her side in the olden days. Why is he clinging to your back?
QuestInfo.1: #p1404005#'s body lies injured, deep in slumber, but his soul roams the world causing havoc! He has learned to possess others to do his bidding. Defeat #r#p1404006##k and rid him of #p1404005#'s spirit!
